_meta.order: Apply FIRST — later plans home products into these part_types.
_meta.note: Every new type carries _why. Delete any entry you reject, then also remove the set_home/merge lines that reference it in the later plans (curate.py will refuse them loudly, so nothing applies silently).

create_part_types.label: Tool Mount
create_part_types._why: PAC Tool fire-tool mounting family (HookLok/HandleLok/axe & Halligan hangers, extinguisher/SCBA mounts) — 10+ products in the queue, no existing home fits (gun_lock is weapons-specific).

create_part_types.label: Computer Pedestal / Mount Base
create_part_types._why: Havis C-HDM/PKG-PSM + Gamber-Johnson pole/base/leg-kit/pedestal ecosystem (~25 queue products): the mounting stack under a docking station. docking_station = the dock itself; motion_attachment = the tilt/swivel only. The in-between structure had no home.

create_part_types.label: Spotlight (pillar/post)
create_part_types._why: Unity 6" pillar spotlights + install kits (~8 queue products incl. two mis-bucketed under qb_unassigned). Distinct slot: aimed post-mounted white light, not a fixed scene light. PARTS_DB_AND_PICKER already anticipates 'spotlight placements' as exception rules.
create_part_types._question: OK to give spotlights their own home (category scene, white)? Alternative is folding them into front_scene like the PAR-46 call.

create_part_types.label: Flashlight & Charger
create_part_types._why: Streamlight SL-20 + Pelican 8060 rechargeable flashlights w/ 12V chargers (3 queue products). The Havis flashlight-charger *pocket* is a faceplate; the light itself had no home.

create_part_types.label: Computer / Laptop
create_part_types._why: Getac S410 laptop is sold as hardware (queue). Homing it under docking_station would misstate what it is.
create_part_types._question: Do you want sold computers in the catalog as their own slot, or treated as an unbilled/agency line like other agency-supplied electronics?

create_part_types.label: Step / Nerf Bars
create_part_types._why: Westin R5 nerf steps (queue). Exterior structural side hardware; nothing existing fits.

create_part_types.label: Utility Trailer
create_part_types._why: JB Lund aluminum utility trailers + rack/ramp/tie-down add-ons (13 queue products, real revenue incl. $6–7k units).
create_part_types._question: Do trailers belong in the vehicle-builder catalog at all, or should they stay QB-only (delete from parts_db)? They never appear on a build sheet.

create_part_types.label: Prisoner Transport Insert
create_part_types._why: Havis PT-series van transport inserts (2 queue products, $6k–$23k). Not a kennel, not a partition — a whole compartment system.

create_part_types.label: Snow Plow
create_part_types._why: SnowEx Power Plow complete kit + deflector (2 queue products, $9.8k unit).
create_part_types._question: Confirm plows are catalog-worthy (municipal truck builds) rather than QB-only.

create_part_types.label: Tonneau / Bed Cover
create_part_types._why: BAK G2 hard folding tonneau (1 queue product).
create_part_types._question: Single product — worth a slot, or fold into step_bars as a generic 'truck exterior accessory' home? Also: BAK Industries manufacturer doesn't exist yet (create via grid before re-branding).
